# docs/images/source-cofdm-constellation.png — pane 3 as the receiver sees it.
#
# Regenerated by scripts/regen-docs-images.sh.  The still's label is this file's
# basename, and that is what names the PNG.

set run.size     1200x828
set run.scale    2
set run.duration 37

# 10 dB is the point of the picture: above the FEC cliff, so frames still decode
# and the map has verdicts to draw, but low enough that the QPSK clouds are
# clouds and the inner code is visibly working.  At the default 35 dB the
# constellation is four dots and the map is empty — a correct picture of nothing
# happening.
set cofdm.cn_db 10.0

# ...and the source never gaps, which is what keeps a `no signal` band out of
# the correction map.  That map is honest about a silence and expensive about
# it: a gap commits rows at the full 60 a second while signal commits one per
# frame arrival, so 2 s of silence buys 120 rows of a 256-row ring and outlives
# every burst the default timing produces.
set cofdm.sig_secs 1.0e9

0.00  source COFDM
0.50  key D                  # decode bar -> Di
1.00  key W                  # pane 3: waterfall -> spectrogram
1.50  key W                  # spectrogram -> constellation + correction map
                             # (two presses, two frames: a repeat count is
                             # frames, and one pass registers one press)

36.00 still source-cofdm-constellation
                             # late enough that the correction map holds no
                             # `no signal` band: its 256 rows fill at ~8.5 a
                             # second at this C/N, counting the frames that
                             # fail, so ~30 s of signal — and 36 is that plus
                             # margin.
